title: Upload or Update Plugin
description: Upload a plugin as a ZIP file. If a plugin with the same name is already installed, it will be replaced after the archive is validated. The archive must include a plugin.json manifest.

success.title: Success
success.description: Plugin uploaded or updated successfully. Application will restart in 5 seconds.

error.title: Error
error.description: Failed to upload plugin. Please check the file format and try again.
